# Writing for your future self {#sec-future-self}

We started this course with the idea that you should not have to re-read your own code. This session is about who does the re-reading, which is you, in about six weeks, having forgotten all of it. We spend the hour on your code rather than mine.

::: {.overview}

## Overview {.unnumbered}

**Duration** 60 minutes

**Questions**

- How do I apply all this to my own work?
- What does it mean to treat code as writing?
- What should I do next?

**What you need this session**

- A session of RStudio open
- A script of your own that you would like to improve

:::
